recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast group portrait of four men in urban attire, framed by heavy black distressed borders and bold, textured green typography. The scene is set in front of a convenience store storefront with visible signage and posters.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group centered against a cluttered storefront background
Bold green display text anchoring the top and bottom of the frame
High-contrast lighting emphasizing metallic jewelry and fabric textures
Rough, scratched black borders framing the central photographic element
coreInvariants: Distressed, weathered texture on all graphical elements
Vibrant green as the primary accent color
Wide-angle perspective creating a sense of presence

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the middle third, varying in seated and leaning postures.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured green logo-like text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top logo down to the central figures, following the lines of their arms and jewelry, ending at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black borders at the top and bottom provide breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green and pink accents against a desaturated, gritty background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, white, green, and denim blue with one warm accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Ultra-wide, heavy slab serif with horizontal striations and distressed edges.
Bottom text: Wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif with small decorative flourishes between words.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top display text are connected by horizontal bars.
Distressed 'scratched' texture applied across the face of the glyphs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display slab serif paired with a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for contrast in weight and density.

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy, industrial feel of the top text.
For the wide-tracked, geometric feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, high-contrast photograph of four men in 2000s-era urban streetwear (oversized shirts, denim, sunglasses, jewelry) sitting in front of a convenience store. Add heavy black distressed borders at the top and bottom with a scratched, weathered texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, ultra-wide green slab-serif logo with horizontal scratch textures at the top. Add a wide-tracked green geometric sans-serif title at the bottom, separated by thin horizontal flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the green vibrant and consistent?
Does the texture look weathered and gritty?
Is the tracking on the bottom text sufficiently wide?
Are the black borders heavily distressed?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the group
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no recognizable logos are present.
Verify the typography is legible despite the texture.
Check that the distressed border doesn't obscure the subjects' faces.
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified roles.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast urban photography with heavy, distressed black framing and bold, textured green display typography for a 2000s hip-hop aesthetic.
